note: The fifth independent review of 1.24.7 (2026-11-07), by an agent that had not seen the rules written, on inputs of its own: 113 replies (money, cooking, farming, building, fluids, units, percentages, averages; kind right or wrong, with the number that is right), 36 recipe questions with a sum (own: whether it is the card's own plain question), 30 pictures (kind right or wrong). 'v1246' is what 1.24.6 gave; 'value', 'speaks', 'after' what this version gives. The pictures as Lantern now draws them were looked at side by side with the pictures as written.
